title: Conservative unlabeled exterior sign repair
origin: Stage55 full pairwise repair improved corrupted graphs but damaged intact graphs. Threshold and K were selected exploratorily on Stage55 only, then frozen here.
repair_rule: Only observed-observed edges may be repaired. Flip a candidate edge sign iff its candidate sign disagrees with the zero-mean sample-correlation sign and absolute sample correlation >=0.10. Query-incident edges remain trusted/correct.
primary: At flip50, conservative repair must have paired-seed sign-accuracy gain lower 95% bound >0 against both no-exterior and batch-128 LOO gate. At intact, repair versus full messages must have lower 95% bound > -0.005. All required.
scope: K=128 and threshold=0.10 were chosen using Stage55 exploratory results, not Stage56 outcomes. Calibration fields are additional unlabeled information/work. Edge support/magnitudes and query-incident signs are trusted.
